title: Argentinian-Style Sausage with Toast
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring Argentinian-style sausage served with crispy toast.

ingredients.name: Argentinian-style sausage
ingredients.notes: Grass-fed and free of added nitrates

ingredients.name: Resinous
ingredients.notes: Optional, add a bit of pine resin for traditional flavor

instructions: Cut the Argentinian-style sausage into 1-inch thick slices.
Place the sausage slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the bread slices by placing them on the oven rack for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Spread 1 tablespoon of Fix on each toasted bread slice.
Serve the Argentinian-style sausage with the toasted bread slices.
